title: Regla 3: concordancia (sustantivos y adjetivos)
source: Slides 18 and 21, plus the Todo sobre mí worksheet
summary: Articles, nouns, and adjectives agree in gender and number. The adjective goes after the noun.
explanation: Rule 3: Articles, nouns, and adjectives must agree in gender (masculine / feminine) and number (singular / plural). Adjectives that describe nouns that are feminine and singular must also be feminine and singular. Nouns that are masculine and plural must be described by adjectives that are also masculine and plural, and so on.

In Spanish the adjective follows the noun: el chico guapo (the good-looking boy), not 'el guapo chico'. From the worksheet: a tall boy = un chico alto; a tall girl = una chica alta; a hard-working man = un hombre trabajador; a hard-working woman = una mujer trabajadora.
With the verb: es = (s/he/it) is, son = (they) are. La calculadora es nueva. Las calculadoras son nuevas.

examples.es: El carro es rápido. Los carros son rápidos.
examples.en: The car is fast. The cars are fast.

examples.es: Tu gato es extraño. Tus gatos son extraños.
examples.en: Your cat is strange. Your cats are strange.
